summary: Two snowmobilers stuck overnight in the North Fork of Fish Creek, several miles above Fish Creek Falls. RCSAR was paged the evening of December 16; incident command deferred the field response to morning given night-time avalanche risk, and the pair maintained a fire through the night. On December 17 Classic Air Medical flew four RCSAR skiers to the top of the drainage and dropped supplies; teams freed the snowmobiles and worked them out of the drainage.
location: North Fork of Fish Creek, above Fish Creek Falls
responding_agency: Routt County Search and Rescue; Classic Air Medical
notes: RCSAR Far Routt Newsletter, Winter Edition (January 2024) — "3 Missions in 12 Hours". Paged evening Dec 16; rescue completed Dec 17.
